entries.name: jsPerf
entries.definition: A website for creating and sharing JavaScript performance tests that run in the visitor's browser.

entries.name: JsRender
entries.definition: A JavaScript template library that renders HTML from templates and data.

entries.name: JsUnit
entries.definition: An early unit-testing framework for JavaScript, modelled on JUnit.

entries.name: JTrac
entries.definition: An open-source, customizable issue-tracking web application written in Java.
variants: JTrac - Open Source And Customizable Issue-Tracking In Java

entries.name: Jury instructions
entries.definition: Drafting and reviewing jury instructions, the statements of law that a judge gives jurors before they decide a case.

entries.name: Jury management
entries.definition: Summoning, qualifying and scheduling the people called for jury service, and looking after them while they serve.

entries.name: Juvenile rehabilitation
entries.definition: Working with young people who have committed offences to change their behaviour and return to society, through counselling, education and supervised programmes.

entries.name: k-means clustering
entries.definition: An unsupervised machine-learning method that splits data into k groups by repeatedly assigning each point to the nearest of k centres and recalculating each centre as the mean of its group.

entries.name: Kahoot!
entries.definition: A game-based learning platform where a host sets quizzes that players answer live on their own devices.

entries.name: KairosDB
entries.definition: A scalable time-series database, originally built on Apache Cassandra, for storing and querying metrics data.

entries.name: Katalon Studio
entries.definition: A test automation tool for web, API, mobile and desktop applications.

entries.name: Kenna Security
entries.definition: A risk-based vulnerability management platform, now part of Cisco, that ranks vulnerabilities by how likely they are to be exploited.

entries.name: Keras
entries.definition: A high-level Python library for building and training neural networks.

entries.name: Kinesitherapy
entries.definition: Treating disease or injury through guided movement and exercise.

entries.name: Kinetic typography
entries.definition: Animating text in motion graphics and video so that its movement and timing carry meaning.

entries.name: Knockout.js
entries.definition: A JavaScript library that binds page elements to data models with declarative bindings, following the model-view-viewmodel pattern.

entries.name: Know Your Third Party (KY3P)
entries.definition: A third-party risk management platform in which firms collect and share due-diligence information on their suppliers and vendors.

entries.name: Knowledge graphs
entries.definition: Representing entities and relationships as structured knowledge.

entries.name: KPI reporting
entries.definition: Collecting key performance indicator data and presenting it in regular reports or dashboards.

entries.name: Kyoto Protocol
entries.definition: An international treaty adopted in 1997 that set binding targets for industrialised countries to cut greenhouse gas emissions.

entries.name: Kyriba
entries.definition: A cloud platform that corporate finance teams use for treasury, cash and risk management.

entries.name: Label edge router
entries.definition: A router at the edge of an MPLS network that adds labels to packets entering the network and removes them as packets leave.

entries.name: Label printer
entries.definition: A printer designed to print text, barcodes and images onto adhesive labels or label stock.

entries.name: Labor market trends
entries.definition: Understanding of how employment, wages and the supply and demand for workers are changing over time.

entries.name: Labour economics
entries.definition: The branch of economics that studies labour markets, wages, employment and unemployment.

entries.name: Labour law
entries.definition: The body of law governing the relationship between employers, employees and trade unions.

entries.name: Land-atmosphere interactions
entries.definition: The study of how the land surface and the atmosphere exchange energy, water, carbon and momentum.

entries.name: Landing page optimization
entries.definition: Improving the design and content of web landing pages, often through testing, to raise the share of visitors who convert.

entries.name: Lando
entries.definition: A command-line tool, built on Docker, for creating and running local development environments.

entries.name: Landscape painting
entries.definition: Painting natural scenery such as hills, fields, water and sky.

entries.name: Landscaping and yard care
entries.definition: Designing, planting and maintaining gardens, lawns and other outdoor spaces around buildings.

entries.name: LangChain
entries.definition: A framework for composing language-model applications.

entries.name: Language interpretation and translation
entries.definition: Converting spoken (interpretation) or written (translation) content from one language into another.

entries.name: Language teaching
entries.definition: Teaching learners to understand, speak, read and write a language, usually one that is not their first.

entries.name: Large language models
entries.definition: Understanding and applying large models of language.

entries.name: Laser engineering
entries.definition: The engineering of lasers and laser-based systems, including their design, building and application.

entries.name: Laser level
entries.definition: A tool that projects a level or plumb line of laser light so that surfaces and fixtures can be aligned on a building site.

entries.name: Laser printing
entries.definition: Printing in which a laser draws an image onto a charged drum that picks up toner and transfers it to paper.

entries.name: Latin American and Latino studies
entries.definition: The interdisciplinary academic study of the history, cultures, politics and societies of Latin America and of Latino communities, especially in the United States.

entries.name: Law enforcement operations
entries.definition: Planning and carrying out the work of police and other law enforcement agencies.
